report: Facebook drove 2,791 leads but showed the largest funnel leakage, with 18.95% L2W, 0.43% L2A, 9 enrollments, and the highest reported CAC of 124,973.44. Referral and website were strongest on conversion at 26.09% and 11.86% L2E respectively, while database’s 92.93% L2W fell to 3.70% W2A; Google led paid sources with 20 enrollments, 3.48% L2E, and 53,098.85 CAC. Spend was available for only 3 of 8 sources, so cost efficiency cannot be assessed for Others, affiliate, database, referral, or website.
